Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/lint job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
